notes.content:

I have put the game at -70% for the steam summer sales. [b]If you bought the game at full price in the last 4 weeks,[/b] contact me via anashel@aliceandsmith.com and I'll send you the difference via paypal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/9b9810c08f31a045c2c5f61a0e9a346405ebaf28.png[/img]
Started pre-covid, our "Going Dark" project is finally completed! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/c79865d98a70bf349517d928e79a5fb766e98e12.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New hacking raid event / Capture the flag
[*] Linux Ubuntu + Gnome now in Beta
[*] Incognito game mode / ability to play without any third party account
[*] Complete removal of Google Analytics tracking from all our websites
[*] Closing our Facebook ad account and removal of all our ads tracking and targeting services
[*] Shutdown of all our newsletter and removal of all email address
[*] Firing our ads agency
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/d4c4494f8f85e939c0aa8e7490651dc4b8086bb7.png[/img]

In incognito mode, your progression is saved to your steam account. You still can play from multiple computers without losing progress. From now on we will rely purely on our community for the growth and success of this game. No more targeted ads, in fact no more advertising agency. If there is a penny to be spent on promoting our game, it will be either to help journalists or fans playing with our games. If you enjoy the game, help us by leaving a review on steam or talk about it with your friends. We will follow shortly with a major rewrite of our legal privacy policy document to now support cloaking, VPN or any form of client anonymity.

For ARG events, The Black Watchmen crossover or any integration that is required to link your game with external projects, you will still be able to keep or create an A&S Accounts. Keep in mind that A&S Accounts and Incognito Mode will not be linked. These are two entirely different login systems so progression won't be shared between accounts.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/18b2c1fc912c7acfe135b2077a2786bb6814ebd2.png[/img]

This update also introduces our hacking events engine. Powered by Unreal Engine, these 'locations' are hosted on our server stack and can be targeted as part of mission or CTF events (Capture the flag). Hacking events can host a single player mission or collective missions. They can be part of storyline missions, bounty or open world.

Some of the unique features you can expect in a hacking event:
[list]
[*] Persistent location that can be targeted with your Stinger OS
[*] Live 24h/7 coverage via Signal Intelligence tools and RTMP Camera Feed
[*] Reset every 4 hours, similar to a dungeon in some MMOs
[*] Each persistent location is also streamed in real-time on Twitch
[*] Ability for bystanders (twitch audience) to interact and affect the location
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/175524e0cbfbd72d1df8b4ab8c33b39b787fce4c.gif[/img]

Using the same technology that we used to build the Paradox Interactive - PDXCON 2021 show, hacking events can include real life actors, similar to what you had during The Black Watchmen live event. For more information, you can watch a 'behind the scenes' clip where I explain the technology:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/e37d112684db3eb2c3156da6e63b6e86f163c90a.png[/img]
https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1032298462?t=09h02m42s

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/5df7a0c85f85b1917568753a1d3f0fdc9dc02c46.png[/img]

It will be a free event for all NT4 owners. Hack an entire city block, control security cameras, take down the power grid and deploy agents on the ground to infiltrate an [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_gap_(networking)]air gap network[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/c13d460eb876b02858707255b4d6404360865a42.png[/img]

notes.title: NITE Team 4 - Going Dark
notes.content:
[b]Deleting all players info. Shutting down our newsletter. Removing all Google Analytics.

To start off this new decade, we at Alice & Smith have challenged ourselves to pursue a world where absolutely none of our players’ information is tracked. None![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/318155c9ccbc7e0d1d81da1a1ef613eccf61c549.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/8d42747bf18c08f85ca0d3fcea416a968c2152ac.gif[/img]

Being an ARG Transmedia company makes this especially challenging, but here is some information on how we plan to change.

During the year, we will migrate our main authentication server and remove all user account creations. You are still going to be able to create or use your existing agent login nickname, but emails will not be used anymore. (No third party account anymore!)

We will delete all your email login data, and we will also purge all IP addresses and filter them in the future. We will update our Terms and Agreement and our Privacy Policy to not only allow Cloaking and VPN technology, but even encourage them.

Google Analytics and all other marketing tracking tools have already been removed from our site, and will be removed shortly from all our other touchpoints.

We are shutting down our newsletter and will delete all account history and tracking data.

We are reducing ingame playstream data to only gameplay and game mechanic optimisations by refactoring much of our code.

These changes WILL NOT impact your gameplay experience, your current progress, or your ability to keep your progress between multiple devices.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/08a39a45266956827322deeab172e46c549a4a2f.png[/img]

Our goal is to not remove the level of immersion you find in our games or projects. We still want you to receive a demonic phone call at 3 in the morning, and infiltrate the *real* website of shady heavy water vendors on the internet.

Green Level Missions, where an elected player is flown to a mystery city for a 48h immersive experience, will still require the same [url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.blackwatchmen.com/archive/uploads/Almanac-2016-WebEdition.pdf]extensive medical and psychological evaluation[/url]. That said, we are working on a new project for our Red, Orange and Yellow clearance levels.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/92fa87d3b80c035122debffe3c8487da9667609a.png[/img]

The concept of creating an ARG companion app is nothing new. Even in one of our earliest ARGs on Unfiction we were talking about having our own dedicated communication platform.

The Black Watchmen series became our pride along with the ARGs we have had the privilege to create for our incredible clients ([url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2019/02/11/paradox-vampire-game/]Paradox Interactive[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QX0QLY_ZuiQ]White Wolf[/url], [url=https://wiki.gamedetectives.net/index.php?title=Waking_Titan]Hello Games[/url], [url=https://www.cyranostory.com/]Funcom[/url]...). It is important for our work to find better ways of staying in connection with you while being able to create puzzles spanning outside the game that blend digital and physical storytelling.

Some of the features we will roll out as part of our companion app:
[list][*] ARG mission alerts
[*] A private secure email address (your-agent-name@arg.gg)
[*] Your own ARG burner phone number (VoIP real landline number)
[*] Chat integration with Google AI for puzzle help and hints
[*] Looking for Group (LFG) system for puzzle solving
[*] Geocaching, dead drop and live drop notifications (Google Map integration)
[/list]

Although we are working on this app for our own needs, we plan to make it open for any ARG creators who wish to utilize it, but don’t have the infrastructure to run it.

If you’d like to follow the project, join our (new) Telegram channel here:
http://t.me/arg_app


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27224498/331f56a2a198f0a1bfcd08d912ff41bc223609ae.png[/img]

There are many, many ways that are much more fun than email! :)

notes.title: Goliath-7 Live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/e6c07d09f9dc99cd651a0a36c72f42748c2302cc.jpg[/img]


[b][h1]Stinger OS Upgrade System Goliath-7 >[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/c7626b23dbab50b5a88e75b16f6b7ccc2504d28d.gif[/img]
Goliath-7 is a new upgrade platform that lets you increase the capacity of your Stinger OS.

[list]
[*] Goliath-7 is a new upgrade platform that lets you increase the capacity of your Stinger OS
[*] CPU upgrades: Boost CPU intensive module like Password Attack
[*] Proxy upgrades: Increase the number of servers you can use to speed up the process of scanning various networks
[*] Database upgrades: Bigger xkeyscore requests, capacity and processing speed
[*] Software upgrades: Add new modules and game mechanics.
[*] Upgrades can be permanent or temporary
[*] Upgrades range in power, from common to legendary
[/list]



[b][h1]New Content >[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/358d5d111216ed29b2c54c2b2827542afa5e2339.jpg[/img]
[b]6 new open-world missions[/b] are released in echo to the unprecedented G7 Cyber Attack simulation in real life ([url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-g7-france-cyber/g7-countries-to-simulate-cross-border-cyber-attack-next-month-france-idUSKCN1SG1KZ]Read more on Reuters[/url]).

In this alternate reality, the vulnerability report prepared by the G7 during the attack simulation has fallen into the wrong hands, and [b]NT4 has to race against time[/b] to plug the leak before attackers can wreak havoc on the US economy.

7 new bounties will also be added to the current world drop. These bounties will give you the chance to infiltrate the infamous SureFire military arms dealer and collect really cool Goliath-7 upgrades along the way.



[b][h1]Twitch Drop 2.0 >[/h1][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/6ad36b1a1771f7d58df33323d82329702f2ab903.jpg[/img]
Watching a NITE Team 4 stream on twitch will now give you a chance to earn a Goliath-7 upgrade item. Every 60 seconds, a loot table will be rolled for everyone watching the stream. If you win, a notification will be displayed in the streamer’s Stinger OS, and the item will be added to your inventory.

We have also added a nice reward for the host. If you are streaming NITE Team 4 on twitch with a minimum of 20 viewers, you will automatically gain an rare, epic or legendary upgrade after 15 minutes. Other rewards will also be earned after 30 minutes, 45 minutes and 60 minutes.

To be eligible, both streamer and spectators need to enable their twitch drop setting here: [url=https://twitch.niteteam4.com]Twitch Drop Campaign[/url].

Our [url=http://discord.gg/arg]Discord Server[/url] now features a stream's channel where you can get alerts of any ongoing stream within the community.

Watching a stream as a group can be fun and also rewarding. We are planning to add special events, missions, and bounties that will be unlocked by all participants in a stream and could be played as a group. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.9
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/fd098305d34e3497bd1b93e942232e1032e797fb.jpg[/img]

Hello agents,

Before we start production on the next Open World mission, we wanted to take some quality time to revise the different aspects of StingerOS’s UI that we thought could use some improvements.

We’ve listened to you, the community, and implemented many of the suggestions that were heavily requested. We think these changes will make StingerOS more intuitive and enjoyable to use.

Here are the patch notes :

[h1]New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to resize Terminals and Image Viewer windows.
[*] The UI is more responsive and the elements on the top corners will now collapse when a module or terminal is near them. This was done to alleviate the UI depending on the needs of the player.
[*] Multi-Monitor Support (Beta) has been added to the game for up to 3 monitors. The feature requires that all monitors be on the same native resolution before starting the game in order to work properly.
[*] Drastically reduced loading time at the start of the game, allowing faster access to the Mission Center.
[*] Added an option allowing you to set the opacity for active and inactive windows.
[*] The Open World and Bounty missions have now been moved to the Mission Center interface, alongside the Academy and Story Mode. All of the game’s primary content can now be accessed in one area.
[*] Open World and Bounty missions will now unlock in tandem with Story Mode, after completing Basic Operations in the Academy. This is to allow a better game flow for new players.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the level up from 2 to 3 to not properly trigger at the end of CastleIvy.
[*] Fixed a bug in the CMS that prevented players from accessing file browsers created in the legacy API.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Open World mission objective to properly refresh when resetting the mission.
[*] Fixed a bug in Xkeyscore where a removed entity would still be considered in a search when it should have been removed entirely
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Active Directory and File browsers to refresh automatically whenever a command was made in another workspace.
[*] Fixed an interface bug caused by having multiple Phone CID Backdoor modules opened on the same workspace.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Xkeyscore to continue scanning after clicking on the Reset button.
[*] The input field for the Active Directory and FileBrowser is now much longer, to cover it’s perceived length.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the resolution setting to save properly
[/list]

notes.title: Hacking: Cyber Range
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/8d51286136eb5e2968710cfa5ecd8498bd060cd2.jpg[/img]

[h1]The new patch introduces the largest and most complex update we’ve ever had in the last two years of development. Partnership with Uplink, new Hivemind Cyber Range universe, the launch of the Game Editor Toolset and more![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/8b29c91d375fc9185361645f14bcd2f4be24a8c5.gif[/img]

Hivemind was initially a covert communications network between Intelligence Agencies, similar to SIPRnet. Over time, mercenary organisations joined the network and it is now an underground cyber range, a virtual environment used for cyber-warfare training and technical development. It provides tools that help strengthen the stability, security and performance of cyberinfrastructures and IT systems used by government and military agencies.

As a player, you can access this sandbox via the Hivemind icon at the bottom of your screen, (5th Icon). More than 63 Hiveminds are currently being built with a variety of difficulties and challenges. It’s a huge undertaking and we hope it will add a completely new playstyle to NITE Team 4.

Player Created Servers can be rated based on fun, difficulty and content quality. You also have the average time it will take to break in. Other types of ratings and filters will be added later, to give you more control over what type of cyber range you wish to play with.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/7dfd71caafdca68afa1408daa422a6ef2121cf12.png[/img]

[img]https://s3.amazonaws.com/media.niteteam4.com/uplink.png[/img]

In 2001, Introversion Software had created a game that would kick off a genre: hacking simulation game. Uplink has won countless awards and achieved a cult status for many members in the hacking games community.

Starting today, all Uplink owners will automatically get a unique Stinger OS skin. To unlock the skin, you just need to have Uplink in your steam library.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/21782b2058b62d5663978d8a76de128b1cb31ca9.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/4de0838aa4f7a9feac42b1070af26ac717b5a631.jpg[/img]

Owners of the Network Administrator can design and create their own Cyber Range in the Hivemind network. In the Stinger OS, a new icon on your left will give you a link to the game editor.

Network Administrator has access to a dashboard showing how many players have access to the cyber range, who succeeded and the global experience they had. The editor includes the same tools we used to design and create all of the missions in NITE Team 4 with some limitations, to keep things simple.

You can create your own technologies and vulnerabilities. Design puzzles of any type, with many network layers to break in and investigate. Advanced Module includes File Browser support, Active Directory, Smart Phone and even Man in the Middle attacks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/544390/extras/01-BootCamp.jpg[/img]

Cheers!

notes.content:

[b]Open World - Early Access and more!!![/b]

Patrick Greatbatch (co-author of The Black Watchmen) is back with a new set of open-world missions starting in October! Open-world missions blend in-game investigation with real world research involving websites, emails, phone numbers, etc. to increase the level of immersion and realism.

The first set of missions takes the player into the inner workings of a secretive government organization, private prisons and deep-rooted political corruption. The investigation is ripped from the headlines and explores complex problems facing real world governments today.

With the release of Early Access comes a set of new rewards! NT4 Hoodies, Military Backpacks, Trench Coats and The Park (Steam Key). To celebrate the event we have created 3 new NT4 Skin for each of the Secret World Legends factions: Illuminati, Dragon and Templar.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/0e00532d27f972f51ad28d4f3b523c7feb41fa15.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! We are excited to show you some of our ongoing work on the Academy, the training and tutorial center of NT4.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/6adba0eb8e04fad257ebcb1487e2d263df6e0d75.jpg[/img]

The Academy will include 5 certifications and 15 training missions at launch. These will teach you about the various tools and techniques featured in Stinger OS. Certification topics include:
[list]
[*]Network Intrusion
[*]Open Source Intelligence
[*]Social Engineering
[*]Data Forensics
[*]Advanced Attack Vectors
[*]And many more...
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/eede0feafd4469a87547e38a9af245b1cef4e475.jpg[/img]

The goal of the certification center is to give you everything you need to know to master all of your hacking modules, attack strategies, and features of the Stinger OS. (Workspaces, multithreading, advanced terminal commands, etc…)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27224498/97a3191cbf35d862dd669a368283a4ff3e717eff.jpg[/img]

You will be able to earn three levels of mastery for each certification. (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) These levels are based on the speed and precision of your attack. For example, to identify potential entry points on an external network, OSINTSCAN should always be your first source for information gathering, since it is less noticeable than a SFUZZER dictionary attack on a DNS server.

Next week, we will introduce our new Social Engineering Toolkit for mass mailing and spear phishing a target network.
